verdict.rationale: Proa is a web framework that emits client-side JavaScript islands, so an officially supported browser matrix is a fair thing for buyers to ask about. The evidence pack never documents supported browsers, minimum versions or polyfill guidance. The CSS-only builds and the small JS runtime are adjacent features and do not establish a browser support policy.

support.subject: As a developer, I know the framework's officially supported browser matrix so I can plan polyfills or decide when to drop legacy support
